Good Food and Good People.
May 2019 • Family
We visited a Sunday afternoon and the place was not too crowded. As we arrived we were quickly greeted and shown to our table. The place looks nice and clean. It has a "fancy" vibe, but nothing to pretentious. Lighting is just right to set a good ambiance. Staff was pleasant and attentive.

But enough of that, we go to restaurants for food, right?

We order a couple of curries, Pad Thai, and a fried fish dish. And all were good.

- Green Curry with Chicken/Beef

The flavor was spot on, chicken was cooked very well and the dish was presented nicely. The order that came with beef was just a bit on the tough side, but nothing terrible. The portion is a good size, but it was lacking rice. It was served with what can only be described as tortillas, interesting choice. My main complaint with this dish is that it was more runny than I am used to. To a certain extent it seemed a bit more on the "soup" side of things, but still very tasty.

-Pad Thai with Chicken

This dish was very good. The presentation was on the fancy side and it made the portion seem small, but once you dig into it its a nice large portion. The noodles were well cooked, chicken was spot on and the seasoning was good. I personally like a bit more spice on mine, but it was good enough that I could do without. No big complaints with this dish.

- Fried Red Tilapia Fish Thai Style

This one was my favorite of all the dishes we had this day. A whole fish filleted and, cut into pieces and fried. Perfectly fried that is, and very well seasoned. Crunchy on the outside and tender on the inside. We really enjoyed this one. It came with a side of green mango salad which was also very good, and also with a bit of simple slaw. Would come back just for this fish. 

- Fried Rice With Pork

Interestingly enough this was the one that they had trouble with. The rice was a bit under seasoned and the egg came very very overcooked. We returned the dish once, which they were glad to replace, but the egg came pretty much over cooked again. This was for my 4 year old daughter so she did not complain much, but she still missed the runny egg. 

Overall we had a very good experience, we would definitely come back and try this again and would recommend this place to anyone looking for some "authentic" Thai food. Might not be exactly the same, but gets close and is very enjoyable.

Mouth-watering Thai food, ambience and service
Nov 2018 • Couples
We ordered two different types of Thai curries, and the chef got the subtle nuanced differences right! Love the beautiful food presentations too - our Tom Kha Gai was in a carved coconut which did such a great job in retaining the fragrance and the heat! Our juicy crab was also generously drenched and the presence of the Thai pea eggplant in it was a confirmation of their Thai authenticity. We were stuffed but couldn't resist slurping up the two dishes.

We went early at 7pm on a Friday and managed to get a quiet table by the window. Given its popularity and availability of numerous good wines to select from, we witnessed that it gets more crowded after 8pm. Nonetheless the ambience was still great and not too noisy as their tables were well-spaced over their one and a half floor. And yes, their servers do speak good English and was able to communicate clearly regarding the dishes we ordered.

Very pleasantly surprised. Excellent service, flexible authentic Thai kitchen and chef.
Feb 2018 • Couples
Most Thai restaurants in Saigon are not authentic and the food is often sort of a fusion between what locals believe is 'Thai food' and actual Thai food with real Thai flavours. However, Bangkok kitchen is exceptional. The chef and kitchen are authentic Thai and in my case the chef even came out to talk to me to find out (in Thai) what dishes I wanted that weren't on the menu- this is super rare in Saigon and I was amazed:)) 
 
Also, the waiters were excellent, attentive and English speaking. Quite clearly they had been trained to provide an international service style or one similar to a quality Thai restaurant in Thailand- Excellent!!!!! 

Yes, as a nod to being in Vietnam their were some inauthentic aspects such as 1) No picture of The King and Queen of Thailand above the door as is 'de rigeur' in any real Thai restaurant or any Thai business 2) Chopsticks already set out on the table (except Thai Chinese style Thai restaurants do not use chopsticks unless specifically requested- they use a fork and spoon) 3) The menu items described fairly vaguely in English and then in Vietnamese (what would be ideal is to have original Thai language names in Thai, then a Romanised version of the Thai names as many people are familiar with the Thai names of dishes (Larb moo, Tom Yam Goong, Gaeng Pa, etc) and then of course descriptions in English and Vietnamese, To their credit though the Thai chef recognised all the Thai names of dishes as you would expect and even asked if I wanted the food 'Thai style' or more 'localised' (read- less spicy!).

So, with the exception of these cosmetic points which give the restaurant away as not 100% authentic Thai, I am still giving 5 stars because the food and service were so exceptional. 

One final thing guys! Please have a nice Thai whisky like MeKong or Sang Som and a good Thai draft beer available. That would be the final luxury of all:)))))

Real Thai food
Nov 2017 • Couples
This Thai restaurant is what we'd been waiting for in Phu My Hung. Real Thai food by Thai Chefs. You can see this as they have an open Kitchen you can view and watch them prepare your food.

We love Thai food and this place hit's the spot. My husband love the Tom kha. WE've eaten here a few times and have not been dissapointed.

Flavours are true Thai. My only complaint is they need more veggies in their meals (but I am a bit of a veggosaurus). Size portions are great, they may seem a little small, but are acually filling. My fave dish is the Pad Thai, best I've had anywhere. 

The dining experience is quite fine. As in more fine dining. Very well set out. They even have an upstairs area if you want more private dining experience. The waiters are very attentive and the cooks are too, they come out and check that you are happy with the meal.

They have an extensive wine list/ rack too. So far everything has been really good. They do a great Lunch special too, 65.000vnd with choice or pork, chicken, or beef stir-fry- spicy of course. Great value for Phu My Hung.
